description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

 

About the role

Ever walked into a local game store on release night and felt the buzz? That energy starts with stores getting into the Wizards Play Network, and that is where this role comes in. As a WPN Application Specialist, the contractor reviews retailer applications across North America and helps new stores get approved quickly and accurately, so they can open their doors to players sooner.

This is a contract role focused on reviewing and approving applications rather than ongoing store coaching. It is a great fit for someone who loves getting the details right and takes real satisfaction in clearing a queue well. Curious what a day looks like? Mostly steady, focused review work, with the Retailer Success team close by whenever a case gets interesting.

What the role involves

The specialist reviews WPN retailer applications, account updates, and ownership transfers for North America, approving stores that meet WPN standards and flagging the ones that need a closer look. Keeping retailer records accurate and complete in our internal systems is a core part of the work, and so is following our review process and telling us when a step is unclear so we can make it better.

Along the way, the specialist spots common patterns, like missing information on applications, and shares them with the team so we can make applying easier for stores. On the trickier or unusual cases, senior team members are there to partner and problem-solve together.

What we're looking for

We would love to hear from someone with some experience reviewing applications, or a background in retail, partner operations, or customer service. Strong judgment matters here: the ability to apply clear guidelines consistently and to know when a case is worth a second opinion. Clear and friendly written communication rounds it out, since good notes and clean handoffs keep the whole queue moving. And a genuine care for getting the details right, even on a busy day, goes a long way!

Bonus points if you already know Wizards games or the tabletop gaming community, or if you have worked in tools like Salesforce or Smartsheet. None of these are dealbreakers.

Good to know

This is a fixed-term contract based in North America, and we may extend it as the work continues. You do not need to check every box to apply. If this sounds like you, we would genuinely love to see your application!

The Data Science team at Penguin Random House builds recommendation systems, forecasting models, and AI-powered tools that shape how readers discover books across our platforms. Our team of scientists and engineers develops and operates these systems end-to-end, from research through production.
We are building a dedicated cloud environment on AWS, along with ML platforms that enable our scientists to deliver models to production quickly. We are hiring a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to build and maintain the foundational systems that support this work.
You will build on a mature MLOps foundation and work closely with AI to evolve and run our cloud platform.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design and own core components of our AWS environment used across data science products. Set the standards for how people and AI agents change infrastructure: review, tests and guardrails.

• Build self-service paths to production for scientists: CI/CD pipelines, promotion gates, and automated triggers, so scientists can ship models without hand-holding.

• Help maintain the security, compliance, and reliability of cloud environments.

• Shape the platform roadmap by identifying the infrastructure work that will most unblock our scientists, and keep stakeholders informed as it progresses.

• 5+ years building and running production systems.

• Track record of designing infrastructure components or tooling that other engineers or teams adopted.

• Hands-on cloud experience (AWS preferred).

• You can use AI agents to build and operate systems, and you can show work you shipped this way.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with data scientists and engineers.

• Experience running infrastructure for ML or data-intensive workloads in production, such as model training, batch scoring or model serving.
Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience defining SLOs or SLAs and managing cloud cost for ML production systems.

• Experience with evaluation or error analysis of ML or LLM systems in production.

title: Stage: Évaluation et intégration d’algorithmes de détection et suivi d’objets par deep learning (F/H)
description: Nous recherchons un stagiaire pour évaluer et intégrer des algorithmes de détection et de suivi d’objets basés sur le deep learning (F/H) pour une durée de 6 mois à partir du 1er trimestre 2027 au sein de la division Land & Sea sur le site d’Angoulême. Contexte : Les algorithmes de détection et de suivi basés sur l’apprentissage profond évoluent vite, et leurs performances annoncées se transposent mal à de nouveaux capteurs ou de nouvelles conditions. Notre équipe développe des solutions de vision temps réel et dispose d’une bibliothèque modulaire de pipelines de traitement (C++). Il manque une méthode fiable pour comparer les approches et choisir celles à intégrer. Objectif : Mettre en place une plateforme d’évaluation reproductible, puis intégrer les solutions les plus pertinentes dans la bibliothèque. Missions : Reprise de l’existant. Analyser le module actuel de détection et de suivi, diagnostiquer ses limites de généralisation sur d’autres capteurs et en rendre compte. Données et protocole d’évaluation. Constituer des jeux de données infrarouges et visibles, avec découpage par séquence, tests inter-datasets et métriques normalisées (mAP, HOTA, IDF1, vitesse d’exécution). Benchmark de l’état de l’art. Comparer des détecteurs et des trackers récents, avec entraînement ou fine-tuning, augmentation de données et résultats reproductibles. Intégration. Intégrer les solutions retenues dans la bibliothèque C++ et réaliser des démonstrations. Documentation. Rédiger un guide de décision par cas d’usage et la documentation technique. Profil: Étudiant en informatique spécialisé intelligence art
